title: The process study and parameter influence in Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) of titanium using hot-wire plasma arc welding
authors: Pattarawadee Poolperm
abstract: Abstract This research aims to study and develop the Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) process for titanium alloys utilizing the Hot-Wire Plasma Arc Welding (Hot-Wire PAW) technique. Due to titanium’s high susceptibility to oxidation during melting, a specialized inert gas shielding device was designed. Process optimization was subsequently conducted using a Full Factorial Design of Experiment (DOE) via Minitab software to determine the optimal parameters: a welding speed of 1.83 mm/s, a wire current of 35 A, and a wire feed rate of 0.85 m/min. Microstructural analysis utilizing the EDS technique confirmed the purity of the deposited titanium, indicating zero oxygen contamination. Furthermore, 3D microscopy revealed grain structure variations induced by the repeated thermal cycles inherent to the layer-by-layer deposition process. In-depth mechanical testing also exposed anisotropic behavior; specifically, tensile strength and ductility differed between the vertical and horizontal build directions, with horizontal specimens achieving an Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) of 560.80–693.58 MPa, compared to 631.65–677.10 MPa for vertical specimens. Additionally, Vickers hardness values ranged from 199.8 HV to 266.8 HV, demonstrating a decreasing trend along the height of the specimen. The findings of this study establish a crucial foundation for the cost-effective production of high-quality, large-scale titanium components for advanced industrial applications.
venue: Journal of Engineering and Applied Science

infographic.engineering_relevance: The study shows a practical route to lower-cost, large-scale titanium part fabrication while revealing direction-dependent properties that designers must account for.

zh-Hans.title: 采用热丝等离子弧焊的钛材丝材电弧增材制造（WAAM）过程研究与参数影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究旨在利用热丝等离子弧焊（Hot-Wire PAW）技术，研究并开发用于钛合金的丝材电弧增材制造（WAAM）工艺。由于钛在熔化过程中对氧化高度敏感，设计了一种专用惰性气体保护装置。随后采用 Minitab 软件进行全因子试验设计（DOE）以开展工艺优化，确定最优参数为：焊接速度 1.83 mm/s、送丝电流 35 A、送丝速度 0.85 m/min。利用 EDS 技术的微观组织分析证实了沉积钛的纯净性，表明无氧污染。此外，3D 显微观察揭示了由逐层沉积过程中固有的重复热循环所引起的晶粒结构变化。深入的力学测试也显示出各向异性行为；具体而言，拉伸强度和延展性在垂直与水平构建方向之间存在差异，其中水平试样的极限抗拉强度（UTS）为 560.80–693.58 MPa，而垂直试样为 631.65–677.10 MPa。此外，维氏硬度值范围为 199.8 HV 至 266.8 HV，表明其沿试样高度方向呈下降趋势。本研究结果为低成本生产高质量、大尺寸钛合金构件、并应用于先进工业领域奠定了重要基础。

infographic.key_insight: 在优化保护条件和工艺参数后，热丝等离子弧 WAAM 能够制备几何形貌可控且高纯度的钛沉积层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究展示了一条降低钛零件制造成本、实现大尺寸构件成形的可行路径，同时揭示了设计者必须考虑的方向相关性能。
method: 设计了一套专用惰性气体保护系统，以保护熔融钛免受氧化。
使用 Minitab 中的全因子 DOE 优化焊接速度、送丝电流和送丝速度。
通过 EDS、3D 显微观察以及垂直和水平方向的力学测试验证沉积质量。
infographic.evidence_signal: 优化后的工艺实现了零氧污染；水平样品的 UTS 为 560.80–693.58 MPa，垂直样品为 631.65–677.10 MPa，硬度范围为 199.8 至 266.8 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 沉积钛表现出各向异性力学行为以及沿构建高度的硬度变化，因此在设计和认证中必须考虑取向和层历史。

title: Effect of Al₂O₃ Addition on the Surface Roughness, Adhesion Strength, and Microstructure of Flame-Sprayed Cu–Al–Ni–Fe Alloy Coatings
authors: Haneen S.Abdulwahid, Rafea A.Munef
abstract: This study aims to synthesize (Cu-Al-Ni-Fe) alloy composite coatings reinforced with alumina (Al2O3) particles at weight fractions of 0 wt%, 3 wt %, and 6 wt%, deposited on AISI 304L stainless steel substrates using the flame thermal spraying technique. The coatings were evaluated by measuring surface roughness and adhesion strength, alongside microstructural and elemental characterization via Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS). The SEM results revealed that the surface roughness of the samples increased from 5 to 8 µm and the adhesion strength increased from 22±0.655 Mpa to 26±0.818 Mpa As the Al2O3 content was increased, SEM micrographs showed reduced porosity and microcracks and improved homogeneity of the microstructure. Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS) the presence of the main constituents of alloy (Cu,Al,Ni,Fe) and elements associated with the Al2O3 reinforcement. The incorporation of Al2O3 particles significantly contribute to the structural and mechanical properties of developed composite coatings as a whole
venue: International Journal of Multidisciplinary Research Updates

infographic.engineering_relevance: Al2O3 reinforcement can be used to tune thermal-sprayed coating performance on stainless steel for better bonding and denser, more durable surfaces.

Evaluated surface roughness and adhesion strength

zh-Hans.title: Al₂O₃添加对火焰喷涂Cu–Al–Ni–Fe合金涂层表面粗糙度、黏附强度和显微组织的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在采用火焰热喷涂技术，在AISI 304L不锈钢基体上沉积以氧化铝（Al2O3）颗粒增强的（Cu-Al-Ni-Fe）合金复合涂层，其Al2O3质量分数分别为0 wt%、3 wt%和6 wt%。通过测量表面粗糙度和黏附强度对涂层进行评估，同时采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能谱X射线分析（EDS）进行显微组织与元素表征。SEM结果表明，随着Al2O3含量增加，样品表面粗糙度由5 µm增加到8 µm，黏附强度由22±0.655 Mpa提高到26±0.818 Mpa。随着Al2O3含量增加，SEM显微照片显示孔隙率和微裂纹减少，显微组织均匀性得到改善。能谱X射线分析（EDS）表明，合金的主要组元（Cu、Al、Ni、Fe）以及与Al2O3增强体相关的元素均存在。Al2O3颗粒的加入对所制备复合涂层整体的结构和力学性能具有显著贡献。

infographic.key_insight: 向火焰喷涂Cu–Al–Ni–Fe涂层中加入Al2O3（3–6 wt%）可提高黏附性和显微组织质量，同时也会增加表面粗糙度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: Al2O3增强可用于调控不锈钢热喷涂涂层性能，以获得更好的结合以及更致密、更耐久的表面。
method: 在AISI 304L不锈钢上火焰喷涂含0、3和6 wt% Al2O3的Cu–Al–Ni–Fe合金涂层
评估表面粗糙度和黏附强度
采用SEM和EDS分析显微组织及元素组成

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.
venue: Progress in Engineering Science

infographic.key_insight: A 190 mm spray distance produced the most compact Cr3C2–NiCr coating and the best corrosion resistance on DSS 2205 in 1 M H2SO4.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing detonation-gun spray distance is a practical lever for improving coating integrity and extending the service life of stainless steel components in acidic industrial environments.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Evaluated corrosion behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, and potentiodynamic polarization.
Compared surface morphology and porosity by SEM to link microstructure with performance.

infographic.watch_item: The optimum distance was established under one electrolyte, room temperature, and a limited set of spray distances, so broader operating conditions may shift the best setting.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments

zh-Hans.title: D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层喷涂距离对酸性环境中DSS 2205性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层是陶瓷硬度与金属性韧性的结合体，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂枪（D-gun）喷涂是最有前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2-NiCr涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀特性而被认为是合适的。本研究采用1 M H2SO4这一标准实验室电解质，在严苛酸性条件下评估D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的有效性；该电解质用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性。研究同时考察了包括喷涂距离在内的关键工艺变量，而喷涂距离对孔隙率、结合强度、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定至关重要。将2205双相不锈钢（DSS）分别在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm三种喷涂距离下喷涂Cr3C2-NiCr，以研究Cr3C2-NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下评估涂层在1 M H2SO4溶液中的电化学活性。SEM下的表面形貌分析表明，涂层呈致密层状结构，孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔融程度和涂层致密性有所提高。190 mm处沉积的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，其腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆基体的腐蚀速率为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀且致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是制备DSS 2205上高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在严苛酸性工业环境中运行的部件提供更优的耐腐蚀保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺—微观结构—性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提升严苛酸性环境中的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 190 mm喷涂距离在1 M H2SO4中于DSS 2205上形成了最致密的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层，并表现出最佳耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化爆炸喷涂距离是提高涂层完整性、延长不锈钢部件在酸性工业环境中服役寿命的实用手段。
method: 在DSS 2205上以170、180和190 mm的距离D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr。
采用OCP、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化在1 M H2SO4中评估腐蚀行为。
通过SEM比较表面形貌和孔隙率，将微观结构与性能联系起来。
infographic.evidence_signal: 孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，且190 mm涂层的腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆DSS 2205为2.60 mmpy。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳距离是在一种电解质、室温以及有限喷涂距离范围内确定的，因此在更宽的工况下最佳设定可能会发生变化。

title: Metallization on CFRP: Effect of Interlayers and Deposition Methods for Aerospace Applications
authors: Nikita Shukla, Beatriz Garrido, Vicente Albaladejo-Fuentes, Javier Sánchez, Irene García-Cano
abstract: Abstract Carbon fibre reinforced polymers (CFRPs) are increasingly used in aerospace structures owing to their high specific strength and low weight. However, their limited electrical conductivity and anisotropic current transport capability make them susceptible to lightning strike damage, creating a need for conductive and mechanically durable metallization strategies. Effective metallization of CFRP remains challenging due to low surface energy, anisotropy, and thermal sensitivity. This study investigates multilayer metallic coating architectures using Zn, Zn/Al, and Zn/Cu transition layers deposited by arc wire spraying (AWS), combined with Al or Cu topcoats applied via high-pressure cold spraying (HPCS), to improve adhesion and mechanical durability. Adhesion was evaluated through pull-off testing and microstructural analysis. Zn interlayers consistently outperformed Zn/Al (~7 compared with ~ 4-5 MPa). Al topcoats reached 8.4 MPa on four-layer Zn/Al interlayers, whereas Cu topcoats reached 12.1 MPa on four-layer Zn interlayers. Incorporating a Zn/Cu transition layer improved the mechanical integrity of Cu-based coating architectures, shifting the failure location away from the CFRP/coating interface in Zn-based systems. Microstructural analysis confirmed continuous multilayer coatings with effective interparticle bonding, demonstrating the suitability of combining AWS compliant interlayers with HPCS functional topcoats. These findings demonstrate that optimized multilayer architectures—combining compliant Zn-based interlayers, Zn/Cu transition layers, and Cu topcoats—provide a robust and scalable approach for CFRP metallization, enhancing interfacial bonding, mechanical integrity, and electrical functionality, and highlighting their potential for future aerospace lightning strike protection applications.
venue: Journal of Thermal Spray Technology

infographic.key_insight: A Zn-based compliant interlayer, especially when paired with a Zn/Cu transition layer, enables much stronger and more durable metallic coatings on CFRP than simpler interlayers.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This multilayer metallization approach improves adhesion and electrical functionality for aerospace CFRP, making it promising for lightning strike protection while preserving lightweight structures.
method: Deposit Zn, Zn/Al, or Zn/Cu interlayers on CFRP by arc wire spraying (AWS).
Apply Al or Cu topcoats using high-pressure cold spraying (HPCS).
Compare coating integrity and adhesion using pull-off tests and microstructural analysis.
infographic.evidence_signal: Pull-off testing showed Zn interlayers near ~7 MPa versus ~4–5 MPa for Zn/Al, with Al topcoats reaching 8.4 MPa and Cu topcoats reaching 12.1 MPa on optimized multilayer stacks.
infographic.watch_item: Thermal and mechanical compatibility with CFRP remains critical, so process control is needed to avoid substrate damage and ensure consistent interfacial bonding.
infographic.paper_title: Metallization on CFRP: Effect of Interlayers and Deposition Methods for Aerospace Applications

zh-Hans.title: CFRP上的金属化：用于航空航天应用的中间层和沉积方法的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRPs）因其高比强度和低重量而越来越多地用于航空航天结构。然而，其有限的电导率和各向异性的电流传输能力使其易受雷击损伤，因此需要兼具导电性和机械耐久性的金属化策略。由于表面能低、各向异性以及热敏感性，CFRP的有效金属化仍然具有挑战性。本研究考察了多层金属涂层结构，采用电弧丝喷涂（AWS）沉积Zn、Zn/Al和Zn/Cu过渡层，并结合高压冷喷涂（HPCS）施加Al或Cu面层，以提高附着力和机械耐久性。通过拉脱测试和微观结构分析评估附着力。Zn中间层始终优于Zn/Al（约7 MPa，相比约4–5 MPa）。在四层Zn/Al中间层上，Al面层达到8.4 MPa，而在四层Zn中间层上，Cu面层达到12.1 MPa。引入Zn/Cu过渡层提高了基于Cu的涂层结构的机械完整性，使失效位置在基于Zn的体系中从CFRP/涂层界面移开。微观结构分析证实了连续的多层涂层及有效的颗粒间结合，表明将AWS的顺应性中间层与HPCS功能性面层结合是可行的。这些结果表明，优化的多层结构——结合顺应性的Zn基中间层、Zn/Cu过渡层和Cu面层——为CFRP金属化提供了一种稳健且可扩展的方法，能够增强界面结合、机械完整性和电功能，并凸显其在未来航空航天雷击防护应用中的潜力。

infographic.key_insight: Zn基顺应性中间层，尤其与Zn/Cu过渡层配合时，可在CFRP上形成比更简单中间层更强、更耐久的金属涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这种多层金属化方法可提升航空航天CFRP的附着力和电功能，使其在保持轻量化结构的同时，有望用于雷击防护。
method: 通过电弧丝喷涂（AWS）在CFRP上沉积Zn、Zn/Al或Zn/Cu中间层。
使用高压冷喷涂（HPCS）施加Al或Cu面层。
通过拉脱测试和微观结构分析比较涂层完整性和附着力。
infographic.evidence_signal: 拉脱测试显示，Zn中间层约为7 MPa，而Zn/Al约为4–5 MPa；在优化的多层堆叠中，Al面层达到8.4 MPa，Cu面层达到12.1 MPa。
infographic.watch_item: 与CFRP的热和机械相容性仍然至关重要，因此需要工艺控制以避免基体损伤并确保界面结合一致。

title: Research Advances of Surface Strengthening Coatings for Agricultural Machinery and Equipment
authors: Chengyun Cui, Haiyan Ma, 张雨萌, Xinyu Kuang, Xigui Cui
abstract: Agricultural machinery components are subjected to multiple failure challenges, including wear, corrosion, and fatigue, during prolonged service under complex operating conditions. Surface coating technology is a critical approach to enhance service performance and has been extensively studied. This review proposes surface coating strategies for different agricultural machinery facing wear, corrosion, and fatigue conditions, and conducts a comparative analysis of laser cladding, thermal spraying, and physical vapor deposition technologies from the perspectives of wear resistance and field applicability. It classifies component types and failure modes, discusses coating functions, classifications, and analyzes strengthening mechanisms from microstructure, wear, and corrosion perspectives. Finally, the current challenges are summarized, and future development directions are discussed, to guide performance protection strategies for agricultural metal components.
venue: Metals

infographic.key_insight: Surface coating technologies can substantially extend agricultural machinery life by mitigating wear, corrosion, and fatigue across diverse operating conditions.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The review helps engineers choose between laser cladding, thermal spraying, and physical vapor deposition based on component failure mode, durability needs, and field applicability.

Compares laser cladding, thermal spraying, and PVD for wear resistance and practical deployment
Explains strengthening mechanisms from microstructure, wear, and corrosion perspectives

infographic.watch_item: Field performance may differ from lab-based coating behavior, so process selection must account for service complexity, adhesion, cost, and repairability.

zh-Hans.title: 农业机械与装备表面强化涂层研究进展
zh-Hans.abstract: 农业机械部件在复杂工况下长期服役过程中，会面临磨损、腐蚀和疲劳等多重失效挑战。表面涂层技术是提升服役性能的关键途径，已得到广泛研究。本文综述针对不同农业机械在磨损、腐蚀和疲劳条件下的表面涂层策略，并从耐磨性和田间适用性的角度，对激光熔覆、热喷涂和物理气相沉积技术进行了比较分析。文章对部件类型和失效模式进行分类，讨论涂层功能与分类，并从微观组织、磨损和腐蚀三个方面分析强化机理。最后，总结当前挑战并讨论未来发展方向，以指导农业金属部件的性能防护策略。

infographic.key_insight: 表面涂层技术可通过缓解不同工况下的磨损、腐蚀和疲劳，显著延长农业机械寿命。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该综述有助于工程师根据部件失效模式、耐久性需求和田间适用性，在激光熔覆、热喷涂和物理气相沉积之间进行选择。
method: 按失效模式和服役环境对农业部件进行分类
从耐磨性和实际部署角度比较激光熔覆、热喷涂和PVD
从微观组织、磨损和腐蚀三个方面解释强化机理
infographic.evidence_signal: 该论文为涂层策略、技术及强化机理的综述与比较分析，而非新的实验数据集。
infographic.watch_item: 田间性能可能与实验室中的涂层行为不同，因此工艺选择必须考虑服役复杂性、附着力、成本和可修复性。

title: Analysis of tensile properties, fracture characteristics, and microstructural features in friction stir welding of dissimilar aluminium alloys reinforced with Al 2 O 3
authors: R. Raja, Sabitha Jannet, Ebenezer Jacob Dhas D. S, Sabarish S, R. Pandiyarajan, K. Anton Savio Lewise
abstract: In the present investigation, dissimilar aluminium alloys AA2014-T6 and AA5083-H111 were joined using friction stir welding combined with in-situ reinforcement of aluminium oxide (Al2O3) particles. A single V-groove with an included angle of 45° was machined along the welded joint line, into which Al2O3 particles were introduced prior to subsequent friction stir processing. The welded joints were subjected to three friction stir processing passes to promote effective material flow and particle dispersion. Microhardness measurements revealed values of up to 105 VHN in the stir zone, while tensile testing showed an improvement of up to 18% compared to the unreinforced joint. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) observations indicated the distribution of Al2O3 particles and effective mixing within the stir zone, and elemental mapping verified the presence of reinforcement across the processed region. Fractographic analysis indicated predominantly ductile fracture characterized by equiaxed dimples. Wear testing showed that the 9 wt.% Al2O3 condition exhibited the lowest wear rate among the investigated reinforcement levels.
venue: Welding International

infographic.key_insight: Adding in-situ Al2O3 particles during friction stir welding of AA2014-T6/AA5083-H111 improved joint strength and wear resistance, with the best wear performance at 9 wt.% Al2O3.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This shows that friction stir processing with particle reinforcement can simultaneously enhance mechanical and tribological behavior in dissimilar aluminium joints.
method: Machined a 45° single V-groove along the weld line and filled it with Al2O3 particles.
Applied three friction stir processing passes to improve flow and particle dispersion.
Compared reinforced and unreinforced joints using hardness, tensile, SEM/EDS, fracture, and wear tests.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 105 VHN in the stir zone, an 18% tensile improvement over the unreinforced joint, and the lowest wear rate at 9 wt.% Al2O3.
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends on achieving uniform particle dispersion during multi-pass processing, so inconsistent mixing could limit reproducibility in larger-scale welding.
infographic.paper_title: Analysis of tensile properties, fracture characteristics, and microstructural features in friction stir welding of dissimilar aluminium alloys reinforced with Al 2 O 3

zh-Hans.title: 采用Al2O3增强的异种铝合金搅拌摩擦焊接中拉伸性能、断裂特征和微观组织特征分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 在本研究中，异种铝合金AA2014-T6和AA5083-H111通过搅拌摩擦焊接，并结合原位增强氧化铝（Al2O3）颗粒实现连接。在焊缝线上加工出一个包含角为45°的单V形坡口，并在随后进行搅拌摩擦加工之前向其中引入Al2O3颗粒。焊接接头进行了三道搅拌摩擦加工，以促进有效的材料流动和颗粒分散。显微硬度测量表明，搅拌区的硬度高达105 VHN，而拉伸试验显示，相比未增强接头，强度最高提高了18%。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观察表明，Al2O3颗粒在搅拌区内分布，并实现了有效混合；元素映射验证了增强相在加工区域内的存在。断口形貌分析表明，断裂主要为韧性断裂，特征为等轴韧窝。磨损试验显示，在所研究的增强含量中，9 wt.% Al2O3条件具有最低的磨损率。

infographic.key_insight: 在AA2014-T6/AA5083-H111搅拌摩擦焊接过程中加入原位Al2O3颗粒，可提高接头强度和耐磨性，其中9 wt.% Al2O3的耐磨性能最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这表明，结合颗粒增强的搅拌摩擦加工可同时提升异种铝接头的力学性能和摩擦学性能。
method: 沿焊缝线加工45°单V形坡口，并填充Al2O3颗粒。
施加三道搅拌摩擦加工，以改善材料流动和颗粒分散。
通过硬度、拉伸、SEM/EDS、断口和磨损试验，对增强接头与未增强接头进行比较。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告显示，搅拌区硬度最高达105 VHN，拉伸性能较未增强接头提高18%，且在9 wt.% Al2O3时磨损率最低。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能依赖于在多道加工中实现均匀的颗粒分散，因此混合不均可能限制大规模焊接中的重复性。

title: Influence of Tib2 Reinforcement and Tool Traverse Speed on the Structural and Thermal Behavior of Dissimilar Metals (AA7075–AA2024) of Friction Stir Welded Joints: an ABAQUS Study
authors: A. Ramaswamy, M. Pujith, N. Vinod, M. Srikanth, M. Deepak
abstract: Friction Stir Welding (FSW) is a modern solid-state joining technique known for its energy efficiency, strong joints, and minimal environmental impact. This project focuses on joining two dissimilar high-strength aluminium alloys AA7075 and AA2024 using the simulation software ABAQUS. The welding was performed on the plates measuring 200 mm in length, 60 mm in width, and 6 mm in thickness. In this study, a Finite Element (FE) simulation was performed to understand the structural and thermal behaviour during welding. Various process parameters were tested, including tool rotational speed, feed rate and tilt angle to identify the most effective settings for achieving strong and defect-free joints. The simulation showed that the welding parameters were Tool speeds of 1000,2000 and 3000 rpm; Feed rates of 1,2 and 3 mm/sec; Tilt angles of 10,1.50 and 2°. These parameters produced in a moderate peak temperature of approximately 580°C, which is within the ideal plasticization range for both AA7075 and AA2024 without exceeding their melting points. This ensures proper material flow, defect-free weld formation, and maintenance of the mechanical properties.
venue: i-manager s Journal on Material Science

infographic.key_insight: ABAQUS-based FSW simulation indicates that AA7075–AA2024 dissimilar joints can be welded in a safe plasticization window, with process settings strongly shaping thermal and structural response.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps identify parameter ranges that can improve joint quality and reduce defect risk when joining high-strength aluminum alloys by friction stir welding.
method: Modeled AA7075–AA2024 plates (200 × 60 × 6 mm) in ABAQUS.
Varied tool rotational speed, feed rate, and tilt angle.
Assessed structural and thermal behavior to locate favorable welding conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The simulation reports a moderate peak temperature of about 580°C, which is described as suitable for plasticization without reaching the alloys’ melting points.
infographic.watch_item: Because the results are simulation-based, experimental validation is still needed to confirm joint quality, defect suppression, and mechanical performance in practice.
infographic.paper_title: Influence of Tib2 Reinforcement and Tool Traverse Speed on the Structural and Thermal Behavior of Dissimilar Metals (AA7075–AA2024) of Friction Stir Welded Joints: an ABAQUS Study

zh-Hans.title: Tib2增强和工具横移速度对异种金属（AA7075–AA2024）搅拌摩擦焊接头结构与热行为的影响：ABAQUS研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊接（FSW）是一种现代固相连接技术，以其高能效、接头强度高以及对环境影响小而著称。本项目重点研究利用仿真软件ABAQUS连接两种异种高强度铝合金AA7075和AA2024。焊接在长度为200 mm、宽度为60 mm、厚度为6 mm的板材上进行。本研究采用有限元（FE）仿真来理解焊接过程中的结构和热行为。测试了多种工艺参数，包括工具转速、进给速率和倾角，以确定实现高强度、无缺陷接头的最有效设置。仿真表明，焊接参数为工具转速1000、2000和3000 rpm；进给速率1、2和3 mm/sec；倾角10、1.50和2°。这些参数产生了约580°C的中等峰值温度，处于AA7075和AA2024的理想塑化范围内，且未超过其熔点。这确保了适当的材料流动、无缺陷焊缝形成，并保持机械性能。

infographic.key_insight: 基于ABAQUS的FSW仿真表明，AA7075–AA2024异种接头可以在安全的塑化窗口内焊接，工艺参数会显著影响热响应和结构响应。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究有助于确定可提升接头质量并降低缺陷风险的参数范围，适用于通过搅拌摩擦焊连接高强度铝合金。
method: 在ABAQUS中建立AA7075–AA2024板材模型（200 × 60 × 6 mm）。
改变工具转速、进给速率和倾角。
评估结构和热行为以确定有利的焊接条件。
infographic.evidence_signal: 仿真报告的峰值温度约为580°C，被描述为适合塑化且未达到合金熔点。
infographic.watch_item: 由于结果基于仿真，仍需实验验证，以确认接头质量、缺陷抑制效果以及实际机械性能。

title: Early detection of groove defect in friction stir welding through data-driven process monitoring
authors: Ersilia Cozzolino, Vitantonio Esperto, Felice Rubino, Antonello Astarita, Pierpaolo Carlone
abstract: Abstract Friction stir welding (FSW) is widely employed for joining aluminum alloys in aerospace and transportation applications. However, process instabilities may lead to groove defects that compromise joint quality and often become evident only after their macroscopic manifestation. Existing monitoring approaches frequently rely on dedicated sensors, such as dynamometers, accelerometers, or acoustic-emission systems, increasing system complexity and implementation costs. This study proposes a data-driven approach for the early detection of groove defects based on electrical current signals acquired from the spindle and machine axes of a CNC machining center used for FSW. Defect-free and groove-defective lap joints of dissimilar AA2139 and AA7075 aluminum alloys were produced and analyzed through signal segmentation, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), power spectral density (PSD), and spectral coherence analysis. The monitoring methodology was subsequently tested on a weld exhibiting transient groove formation and correlated with X-ray computed tomography (XCT) observations. The results showed that spindle current signals provide the most sensitive indication of groove-defect formation. Defect-free weld regions exhibited high spectral coherence values, whereas defective regions were characterized by a significant reduction in coherence at the spindle fundamental frequency and its harmonics. XCT analyses confirmed that these signal variations are associated with the development of subsurface discontinuities preceding the appearance of visible surface grooves. The proposed methodology identified process instabilities within approximately 10 s from defect initiation, demonstrating the existence of an incubation stage before the macroscopic manifestation of the groove defect. The approach only requires low-cost current measurements readily available in industrial CNC machining centers used for FSW, making it suitable for industrial implementation and a promising tool for real-time FSW monitoring and quality control.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: Spindle current signal coherence can reveal groove defect formation in friction stir welding before the defect becomes visibly apparent.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This enables low-cost, sensor-light real-time monitoring of FSW on standard CNC machining centers for earlier quality control and process intervention.
method: Segment spindle and axis current signals from defect-free and defected FSW runs
Extract FFT, PSD, and spectral coherence features
Compare signal changes against XCT for transient groove formation
infographic.evidence_signal: The study found that defective regions showed a marked drop in coherence at the spindle fundamental frequency and harmonics, with process instabilities detected about 10 s after defect initiation and confirmed by XCT.
infographic.watch_item: Performance may depend on machine-specific current signatures, so calibration and validation are needed before deployment across different CNC/FSW setups.
infographic.paper_title: Early detection of groove defect in friction stir welding through data-driven process monitoring

zh-Hans.title: 通过数据驱动的过程监测实现摩擦搅拌焊中沟槽缺陷的早期检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 摩擦搅拌焊（FSW）广泛用于航空航天和交通运输领域中铝合金的连接。然而，过程不稳定性可能导致沟槽缺陷，从而损害接头质量，并且这类缺陷通常只有在其宏观表现出来后才会变得明显。现有监测方法往往依赖测力计、加速度计或声发射系统等专用传感器，增加了系统复杂性和实施成本。本研究提出一种基于数据驱动的方法，利用用于FSW的CNC加工中心主轴和机床各轴采集的电流信号，对沟槽缺陷进行早期检测。采用异种AA2139和AA7075铝合金制备了无缺陷和存在沟槽缺陷的搭接接头，并通过信号分割、快速傅里叶变换（FFT）、功率谱密度（PSD）和谱相干性分析进行研究。随后将该监测方法应用于一条呈现瞬态沟槽形成的焊缝，并与X射线计算机断层扫描（XCT）观察结果进行关联。结果表明，主轴电流信号对沟槽缺陷形成最为敏感。无缺陷焊缝区域表现出较高的谱相干性，而有缺陷区域则在主轴基频及其谐波处的相干性显著降低。XCT分析证实，这些信号变化与可见表面沟槽出现之前形成的亚表面不连续性有关。所提出的方法能够在缺陷起始后约10 s内识别过程不稳定性，表明沟槽缺陷在宏观表现之前存在一个潜伏阶段。该方法仅需FSW工业CNC加工中心中易于获取的低成本电流测量，因而适合工业实施，并有望成为实时FSW监测和质量控制的有力工具。

infographic.key_insight: 主轴电流信号的相干性可在摩擦搅拌焊中沟槽缺陷变得可见之前揭示其形成。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这使得在标准CNC加工中心上以低成本、少传感器的方式对FSW进行实时监测成为可能，从而更早实施质量控制和过程干预。
method: 对无缺陷和有缺陷的FSW运行中的主轴及各轴电流信号进行分段
提取FFT、PSD和谱相干性特征
将信号变化与瞬态沟槽形成的XCT结果进行比较
infographic.evidence_signal: 研究发现，有缺陷区域在主轴基频及其谐波处的相干性明显下降，且在缺陷起始约10 s后检测到过程不稳定性，并经XCT证实。
infographic.watch_item: 性能可能取决于机床特定的电流特征，因此在推广到不同的CNC/FSW配置之前需要进行校准和验证。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting Xia, Yueming WANG, Lu Xie
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.
venue: Materials Science

infographic.key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr thermal-sprayed coatings, HVOF and HVAF delivered the best wear performance, while HVAF gave the strongest corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting the spray process strongly changes coating microstructure and service performance, so process choice can be optimized for either wear-critical or corrosion-critical applications on stainless steel components.
method: WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were deposited on 304 stainless steel by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Microstructure was compared alongside hardness, tribological response, and electrochemical corrosion behavior.
Wear tracks and corrosion metrics were used to rank coating performance across processes.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports hardness of 771.4, 954.2, 1166.2, and 1162.2 HV and wear rates of 7.93, 1.51, 1.17, and 1.10 ×10^-5 mm3/N·m for APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, respectively, with HVAF showing the best corrosion metrics.
infographic.watch_item: Performance rankings are specific to the reported test conditions, so field service behavior may differ with load, environment, and substrate preparation.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂 WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层的微观结构、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐腐蚀性。采用不同热喷涂技术，包括大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS），分别在 304 不锈钢基体上制备了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。系统研究并比较了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的微观结构、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性。结果表明，通过 APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 制备的硬质涂层的维氏硬度均高于 304 不锈钢，分别为 771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV 和 1162.2 HV。304 不锈钢的体积磨损率约为 (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层的体积磨损率均低于 304 不锈钢，分别约为 (7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5 和 (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304 不锈钢基体、APS 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 HVAF 涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为 (0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01) 和 (0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的磨痕中可见剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于 APS。并且，HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层具有更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为 HVAF 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 APS 涂层。其中，HVAF 涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的耐腐蚀性（20438.5 Ω）。APS 涂层在这四种涂层中耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在 WC-10Co-4Cr 热喷涂涂层中，HVOF 和 HVAF 表现出最佳耐磨性能，而 HVAF 具有最强的耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 喷涂工艺的选择会显著改变涂层微观结构和服役性能，因此可针对不锈钢部件中以耐磨为主或以耐腐蚀为主的应用优化工艺选择。
method: 采用 APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 在 304 不锈钢上沉积 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。

title: Rupture and growth of holes in the melt pool during laser keyhole welding of thin sheets
authors: Love O. John, Alexander F.H. Kaplan
abstract: Abstract This study investigates the formation and growth of holes during laser keyhole welding of 100 μm thin 316 L stainless-steel sheets in overlap joints, represented by bead-on-plate welding of 200 μm thick foils. Using high-speed imaging, keyhole instabilities, promoted by increasing line energy, were identified as precursors to hole nucleation. Continuous weld seams were obtained up to approximately 7 kJ/m, while hole formation occurred beyond this regime and cutting became dominant above approximately 12 kJ/m. The hole growth mechanism is described by the competition between vertical and horizontal surface-tension components associated with the local melt pool curvature. Once nucleated, holes expanded at approximately 0.8–1.2 m/s over 1–3 ms and developed into elliptical shapes before forming permanent perforations or cuts. A geometric stability criterion based on the Young-Laplace force balance indicates that unstable growth occurs when the hole length becomes comparable to the sheet thickness. The thinner the foil, the stronger the vertical force component promoting hole growth, reaching 17 kN/m² here. A systematic flow chart linking the observed sequence of keyhole instability, hole nucleation, and hole growth provides a basis for identifying precursor signatures and suppressing hole formation during thin-sheet laser welding.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

zh-Hans.title: 薄板激光小孔焊接过程中熔池内孔洞的破裂与生长
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究考察了在搭接接头中对100 μm薄316L不锈钢板进行激光小孔焊接时孔洞的形成与生长，采用200 μm厚箔材的单道堆焊（bead-on-plate）焊接作为表征对象。利用高速成像发现，随着线能量增加而增强的小孔不稳定性是孔洞成核的前驱现象。在线能量约至7 kJ/m时可获得连续焊缝，而在超过该范围后开始出现孔洞形成，并且在约12 kJ/m以上切割占主导。孔洞生长机理可由与局部熔池曲率相关的垂直与水平表面张力分量之间的竞争来描述。一旦成核，孔洞在1–3 ms内以约0.8–1.2 m/s的速度扩展，并在形成永久性穿孔或切割之前发展为椭圆形。基于Young-Laplace力平衡的几何稳定性判据表明，当孔洞长度与板厚相当时，会发生不稳定生长。箔材越薄，促进孔洞生长的垂直力分量越强，此处可达17 kN/m²。将所观察到的小孔不稳定、孔洞成核和孔洞生长的连续过程系统化的流程图，为识别前驱特征以及在薄板激光焊接中抑制孔洞形成提供了基础。

title: Development of a numerical model for microstructural evolution during submerged ARC welding of ASTM A516 GR.70 steel
authors: Serafino Caruso, Romina Conte, Giuseppina Ambrogio, Luigino Filice
abstract: Abstract The present study proposes a coupled thermo-metallurgical Finite Element Model (FEM) that has been specifically designed to simulate the Submerged Arc Welding (SAW) process on ASTM A516 Gr.70 hypoeutectoid steel, with the aim of predicting the extent of the Heat-Affected Zone (HAZ), grain size evolution and hardness variation with respect to phase transformations. The thermal field was modelled by considering a three-dimensional Gaussian volumetric heat source implemented through concentric heat-exchange windows in SFTC DEFORM-3D™ environment, ensuring accurate representation of localized energy deposition and heat conduction. A customized user subroutine was developed to couple the computed thermal cycles with metallurgical transformations by considering phase transformation mechanisms based on the Fe–Fe₃C phase diagram, grain refinement kinetics and phase-fraction-dependent hardness models. Temperature-dependent material properties were included to ensure accurate simulation because phase transformations are highly dependent on cooling rates, especially in hypoeutectoid steels. The numerical results were validated with metallographic and microhardness measurements, showing good agreement in terms of HAZ extension (4%), grain size distribution (< 10%) and hardness values (5%). The numerical and experimental validation presented in this study focuses on pass 2.1 within the investigated multipass joint geometry, selected to minimize the influence of reheating from subsequent welding passes. The results show the capability of the model to reproduce grain refinement in the fine-grained HAZ, grain growth in the solid–liquid transition zone along with the hardness gradient from the base material to the weld bead. Overall, the proposed approach provides a calibrated thermo-metallurgical framework for the prediction of microstructural and mechanical response of ASTM A516 Gr.70 steel during the investigated SAW process. The framework may provide a modelling basis for future Digital Twin-oriented developments, although real-time data assimilation, online updating and bidirectional process communication are beyond the scope of the present study.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

zh-Hans.title: ASTM A516 GR.70钢在埋弧焊过程中的微观组织演化数值模型开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究提出了一种耦合热-冶金有限元模型（FEM），专门用于模拟ASTM A516 Gr.70低共析钢的埋弧焊（SAW）过程，旨在预测热影响区（HAZ）的范围、晶粒尺寸演变以及与相变相关的硬度变化。热场通过在SFTC DEFORM-3D™环境中采用由同心换热窗口实现的三维高斯体积热源进行建模，以确保对局部能量沉积和热传导的准确表征。通过开发定制用户子程序，将计算得到的热循环与冶金转变耦合起来，考虑了基于Fe–Fe₃C相图的相变机制、晶粒细化动力学以及相分数相关的硬度模型。为确保模拟准确性，还纳入了温度依赖的材料性能，因为相变高度依赖于冷却速率，尤其是在低共析钢中。数值结果通过金相和显微硬度测量进行了验证，在HAZ扩展（4%）、晶粒尺寸分布（< 10%）和硬度值（5%）方面均表现出良好一致性。本研究中的数值与实验验证聚焦于所研究多道焊接接头几何中的第2.1道焊缝，该道次的选择旨在尽量减小后续焊道再加热的影响。结果表明，该模型能够再现细晶HAZ中的晶粒细化、固-液转变区中的晶粒长大，以及从母材到焊道的硬度梯度。总体而言，所提出的方法为所研究SAW过程期间ASTM A516 Gr.70钢的微观组织与力学响应预测提供了一个经过校准的热-冶金框架。该框架可为未来面向数字孪生的开发提供建模基础，但实时数据同化、在线更新和双向过程通信不在本研究范围内。

title: Microstructure and wear properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings sprayed by conventional and supersonic high-velocity atmospheric plasma spraying with axial powder feeding
authors: Tadeusz Kubaszek, Anita Słyś, Marek Góral, Marcin Drajewicz, Kamil Gancarczyk
abstract: This study investigated the microstructural evolution and phase transformation mechanisms in Cr₃C₂-NiCr cermet coatings (Metco 5241 powder) plasma-sprayed onto S235 steel substrates.Two technologies were used: conventional atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) with radial powder injection (single-electrode A60 torch) and supersonic plasma spraying with axial powder feeding (HV-APS, three-electrode Axial III torch).The HV-APS coatings exhibited nearly halved porosity (6.16% vs. 11.99% for APS) and significantly higher microhardness (1141 HV0.2 vs. 897 HV0.2).Phase analysis revealed the disappearance of primary Cr 3 C 2 and Cr 21.26 Ni 1.74 C 6 carbides in favour of supersaturated Cr-Ni solid solutions.In the erosion tests conducted at a 90° impact angle, the two coating variants exhibited nearly identical specific erosion rates (0.20 mg/g for APS and 0.19 mg/g for HV-APS) and comparable damage mechanisms, dominated by fatigue-driven lamellar spalling and brittle fracture.However, in tribological tests (ball-on-disc, 30 N load), HV-APS coatings showed nearly 27% lower wear volume (2.85 mm 3 ) and a reduced specific wear rate (1.90 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm) compared to APS (3.90 mm 3 and 2.60 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm, respectively), correlating with their higher density and hardness.The obtained results confirm that the use of axial powder feeding in supersonic HV-APS plasma spraying significantly improves the mechanical and tribological properties of Cr₃C₂-NiCr coatings, although this advantage is not evident in the erosion tests at high impact angles.
venue: Advances in Science and Technology – Research Journal

zh-Hans.title: 采用常规与带轴向送粉的超音速高速大气等离子喷涂制备的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的显微组织与磨损性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了喷涂在 S235 钢基体上的 Cr₃C₂-NiCr 金属陶瓷涂层（Metco 5241 粉末）的显微组织演化和相变机制。采用了两种技术：带径向送粉的常规大气等离子喷涂（APS，单电极 A60 喷枪）以及带轴向送粉的超音速等离子喷涂（HV-APS，三电极 Axial III 喷枪）。HV-APS 涂层表现出近乎减半的孔隙率（6.16% 对比 APS 的 11.99%）以及显著更高的显微硬度（1141 HV0.2 对比 897 HV0.2）。相分析表明，初生 Cr 3 C 2 和 Cr 21.26 Ni 1.74 C 6 碳化物消失，转而形成过饱和 Cr-Ni 固溶体。在 90° 冲击角下进行的冲蚀试验中，两种涂层的比冲蚀率几乎相同（APS 为 0.20 mg/g，HV-APS 为 0.19 mg/g），且损伤机制相近，主要为疲劳驱动的层状剥落和脆性断裂。然而，在摩擦学试验（球-盘，30 N 载荷）中，与 APS 相比，HV-APS 涂层的磨损体积近乎降低 27%（2.85 mm 3），比磨损率也降低（1.90 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm），而 APS 分别为 3.90 mm 3 和 2.60 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm，这与其更高的致密性和硬度相关。所得结果证实，在超音速 HV-APS 等离子喷涂中采用轴向送粉可显著改善 Cr₃C₂-NiCr 涂层的力学和摩擦学性能，尽管这种优势在高冲击角冲蚀试验中并不明显。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.
venue: BULLETIN of D Serikbayev EKTU

title: Painted Reinforced Concrete as an Alternative to Galvanized Steel in Chloride-Rich Environments
authors: Helga S. Matera, Elber V. Bendinelli, Felipe Garcia Nunes, Simone L.D.C. Brasil
abstract: Abstract Galvanization is one of the most common anticorrosive techniques for the protection of metallic structures in atmospheric applications. However, in extremely aggressive atmospheric environments, the material fails to deliver its usual performance, and replacement can be necessary, as in this case study. Painted reinforced concrete has emerged as a promising alternative for extending the service life and enhancing corrosion resistance. They combine the barrier and passivation mechanisms associated with steel reinforcement embedded in concrete with the anticorrosive protection provided by the high-performance coating systems. In this context, this work evaluated the performance of combinations of carbon steel and galvanized steel reinforcement concrete with three commercial coating systems (CS1, CS2, and CS3) under severe conditions expected at the installation site. The test specimens were manufactured using Brazilian CPII cement concrete, and the performance of galvanized steel was assessed in comparison to the expected behavior of carbon steel. Concrete characterization tests were conducted to verify its suitability for the intended application, including water absorption, void index, bulk density, and compressive strength tests, and salt spray exposure tests were performed to assess the anticorrosive performance of the different combinations. Each coating system was individually characterized using techniques to measure its physical and barrier properties, and the reinforcing steels were evaluated for their mechanical properties and chemical compositions. Electrochemical methods, including open-circuit potential monitoring, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, and polarization resistance, were used to complement the other analyses. The results indicated that the traditional carbon-steel-and-concrete system exhibited a superior anticorrosive performance. Even after long-term exposure to salt spray, the specific influence of each coating system applied to the concrete could not be clearly distinguished, given its excellent anticorrosive performance. Despite this, CS3 consistently showed favorable results in the characterization tests and was therefore selected for the final application.

zh-Hans.title: 在富氯环境中，涂装钢筋混凝土作为镀锌钢的替代方案
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 镀锌是用于保护大气环境中金属结构的最常见防腐蚀技术之一。然而，在极端恶劣的大气环境中，该材料无法发挥其通常性能，因此可能需要更换，本案例即属此类。涂装钢筋混凝土已成为延长服役寿命并提高耐腐蚀性的有前景替代方案。它将埋置于混凝土中的钢筋所具有的屏蔽和钝化机制，与高性能涂层体系提供的防腐蚀保护相结合。在此背景下，本研究评估了碳钢和镀锌钢钢筋混凝土与三种商业涂层体系（CS1、CS2 和 CS3）在安装现场预期的严苛条件下的性能。试件采用巴西 CPII 水泥混凝土制备，并将镀锌钢的性能与碳钢的预期行为进行比较。为验证混凝土是否适用于预定应用，进行了吸水率、孔隙率、表观密度和抗压强度测试；并通过盐雾暴露试验评估不同组合的防腐蚀性能。每种涂层体系均采用表征其物理性能和屏蔽性能的技术分别进行表征，钢筋则对其力学性能和化学组成进行评估。还采用电化学方法，包括开路电位监测、电化学阻抗谱和极化电阻，作为其他分析的补充。结果表明，传统的碳钢-混凝土体系具有更优的防腐蚀性能。即使在长时间盐雾暴露后，鉴于其优异的防腐蚀表现，也无法清晰区分施加于混凝土上的各涂层体系的具体影响。尽管如此，CS3 在表征试验中始终表现出有利结果，因此被选用于最终应用。

infographic.key_insight: 在严苛的富氯大气暴露条件下，涂装钢筋混凝土可以作为镀锌钢的实用替代方案，其中碳钢混凝土体系表现出出乎意料的强防腐蚀性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于暴露于严苛海洋或工业大气中的基础设施，当长期耐腐蚀性至关重要时，该研究建议优先采用配有高性能涂层的钢筋混凝土，而非镀锌钢。
method: 采用碳钢或镀锌钢钢筋以及三种商业涂层体系（CS1、CS2、CS3）制备混凝土试件。
通过物理、屏蔽、力学和化学测试对混凝土、涂层和钢材进行表征。
结合盐雾暴露与电化学监测（OCP、EIS、极化电阻）评估腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在长期盐雾和电化学评估中，传统的碳钢-混凝土体系表现最佳，而由于整体防腐蚀性能很强，涂层之间的差异难以区分。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要表明，在所测试条件下涂层效应可能难以区分，因此在广泛应用之前，仍需要现场验证和更长时间的暴露研究。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

zh-Hans.title: 采用爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层方法的开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 体系自熔性涂层组织以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。研究参数包括炮管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次射击间延迟（0–1 s）。涂层的形貌分析表明，其具有典型的层状结构，且涂层厚度和缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的炮管填充率可获得更致密、孔隙率更低的涂层结构，而中等和较高填充率则促进了微裂纹的形成，这可能是由于残余应力增加所致。摩擦学测试表明，在炮管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得最低摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着磨损增加。最高耐磨性出现在 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次射击间延迟增加至 1 s 的条件下，使比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析显示，增加两次射击间延迟可使 Ra 从 5.00 μm 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。对于促进致密结构和强化相形成的一组参数，获得了最高硬度，最高可达 905.6 HV。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数需要在降低摩擦系数和提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。这些研究结果可用于开发机器零部件修复和表面强化技术。

比较涂层形貌、粗糙度、硬度、摩擦和磨损响应。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对基于 Ni–Cr–B–Si 自熔合金涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对基于 Ni–Cr–B–Si 自熔合金涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。选用耐腐蚀的 AISI 321 奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料。采用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧-乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比调整为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2。使用 Accuraspray 4.0 诊断系统监测喷涂参数。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。随着 O₂/C₂H₂ 比的增加，涂层结构趋于致密，孔隙率由 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度由 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度由 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 提高到 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。最高平均显微硬度 1051.7 HV 出现在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 1.1 时。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 时制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制 O₂/C₂H₂ 比可作为调控火焰喷涂 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔合金涂层微观组织和力学特性的有效手段。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone–implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti–HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti–HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（Distal Weight-Bearing Implants，DWBIs）代表一种临床新兴的承重医疗器械类别，其中生物材料设计、表面结构和生物力学性能高度耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨经骨残端康复中恢复远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及骨-植入物界面的生物学需求。本系统综述综合了DWBI概念、几何优化、包含步态相加载的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（Functionally Graded Materials，FGMs）、梯度Ti–HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。针对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度和转化就绪度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床研究仅构成较小的验证层。以HAp为中心的表面或体相材料工程在该文献集合中占据了相当大的比例；然而，关于梯度Ti–HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料和机制类类似研究，支持的是机制可行性，而非DWBI特异性验证。在机制层面，DWBI应被理解为一个集成的生物材料-力学系统，连接宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态相加载、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程。其转化将要求患者真实的载荷条件、经验证的有限元分析工作流、器械级疲劳和涂层完整性测试、标准化体内终点评估、协调一致的康复方案，以及由注册数据库支持的临床随访，以将力学可行性与持久的生物固定和患者层面的获益关联起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端承重植入物作为耦合的生物力学-生物材料系统工作，其中几何形态、梯度涂层和步态相载荷必须协同优化，才能实现持久的骨-植入物整合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该论文强调，这些植入物要转化到临床，取决于经过验证的有限元工作流、疲劳/涂层耐久性测试以及患者真实的机械载荷条件。
method: 关于远端承重植入物设计、生物材料界面与临床转化的系统综述
对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行定量趋势分析
综合有限元分析、功能梯度材料、梯度Ti-HAp结构和体内证据
infographic.evidence_signal: 证据基础仍处于早期阶段，超过一半的实证研究仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物或人体/临床验证相对较少。
infographic.watch_item: 梯度Ti-HAp和FGM概念具有前景，但其中很大一部分支持来自类比生物材料研究，而非DWBI特异性的临床验证。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: UNSM changed the near-surface hardness of Cr3C2–NiCr coatings in a strongly sample-dependent way, with DS coatings reaching 820–970 HV and HVOF coatings spanning a wider 546–1165 HV range.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-resistant coating design, the results show that deposition route and UNSM settings must be tuned together because local mechanical response and surface integrity do not improve uniformly.
method: Detonation-sprayed and HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr coatings were post-treated by ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification.
Four treated samples per route were tested at 20/30 N static load and 20/30 µm vibration amplitude.
Hardness was measured by instrumented indentation at 300 mN for 10 s, and scratch tracks were examined by SEM.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports measured hardness ranges for both coating routes, plus qualitative SEM observations of heterogeneous contrast and crack-like features after scratching, with mean friction coefficients listed as supplementary data.
infographic.watch_item: The scratch microscopy is qualitative and the abstract does not isolate UNSM-induced damage or support a definitive ranking of scratch resistance.

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 对经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度和划痕后表面形貌进行了研究，样品包括爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）沉积层。针对每种沉积工艺评估了 4 个处理样品，静载荷分别为 20 和 30 N，振动幅值分别为 20 和 30 µm。采用 300 mN 载荷、10 s 保载时间测量仪器硬度。DS 样品的硬度值为 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 样品的硬度范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。最高值分别出现在 20 N/20 µm 条件下的 DS-T1 和 30 N/30 µm 条件下的 HVOF-T4。划痕试验后采集的 SEM 图像显示，两组涂层均具有非均匀的表面对比度和类裂纹不连续特征。这些观察结果为试验后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但并不能区分由 UNSM 引起的损伤，也不能建立划痕抗力的排序。可获得的平均摩擦系数作为 6 个处理样品的补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应具有样品依赖性，并强调需要将局部力学性能与表面完整性结合评估。

infographic.key_insight: UNSM 以强烈的样品依赖方式改变了 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层近表层硬度，DS 涂层达到 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 涂层的范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨涂层设计，结果表明必须同时优化沉积工艺和 UNSM 参数，因为局部力学响应与表面完整性并不会一致改善。
method: 对爆炸喷涂和 HVOF 的 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层进行了超声纳米晶表面改性后处理。
每种工艺路线的 4 个处理样品在 20/30 N 静载荷和 20/30 µm 振动幅值条件下进行测试。
采用 300 mN、10 s 的仪器压痕法测量硬度，并用 SEM 检查划痕轨迹。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了两种涂层工艺的实测硬度范围，并给出了划痕后具有非均匀对比度和类裂纹特征的定性 SEM 观察结果，同时将平均摩擦系数作为补充数据列出。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕显微观察为定性结果，摘要未能区分 UNSM 引起的损伤，也不足以支持对划痕抗力作出明确排序。
